title: Update to my game where you go from street runner to god of speed
author: hirikokihiro
selftext:
This video shows most of the content you can expect in the game.  
[https://godrunner789.itch.io/running-god](https://godrunner789.itch.io/running-god)   
Please let me know any feedback! i've updated the ui and changed how much of the balancing works manually for a better experiencie.

comments.author: CertainBlue
comments.body: this actually seems like a pretty cool idea. I assume this is mostly an incremental game but the idea is original enough (or at least I haven't seen it before)

replies.author: hirikokihiro
replies.body: yes its mostly incremental, but there are some game mechanics that require the player to be active and use some skills

comments.author: wiltchamberlainhoe
comments.body: Gotta get off the AI generated graphics and menus or make them at least look non-AI generated. They are nails on a chalk board

replies.author: hirikokihiro
replies.body: have no intention to hide that its made with AI, right now i just did a full rework of the ui to make it more digestible i won't make changes for a while and focus on making the game more fun

replies.author: LeeMojave
replies.body: One thing I did was I took a screenshot of my game and I asked chatgpt to make an image of it with a retro style UI which aligned with my game style. I made changes to the image as I liked then I handed the image over to the agent to implement it into my game. Worked out great and doesn't have that AI generated look.

replies.author: Top_Measurement7815
replies.body: I think the game look good. AI or not it has potential
